planning_basis: Topify EdgeBench DOCX section 2, six categories across the first 100 tasks; targets are planning defaults, not acceptance thresholds

source_pools: storage, search, compiler and codec regressions
task_mechanisms: cross-version compatibility repair with held-out behavior
protocol or data-structure reimplementation from a source-grounded contract
snapshot_artifacts: compiled component and configuration generated from submitted sources
cheap_controls: stock upstream implementation or searchable published fix
reject_if: published solution reaches the reference without real work
only one binary test can change the reward
a build artifact depends on mutable outside-network state

task_mechanisms: held-out model calibration and robust forecasting
policy or solver tuning across seeded distributions
snapshot_artifacts: model weights or solver code under /workspace
configuration and predictions derived only from submitted files
cheap_controls: linear model or standard public pretrained estimator
reject_if: a constant or pretrained shortcut nearly reaches the reference
private labels leak through the development split

task_mechanisms: structured educational or clinical evidence synthesis with objective consistency checks
snapshot_artifacts: structured report and its cited evidence under /workspace
reconciled ledger, spreadsheet or schema-valid decisions
cheap_controls: copying numbers from one source without reconciliation
generic language-model prose without evidence validation
reject_if: subjective prose quality dominates the score
rights or personal-data basis remains unknown at promotion

task_mechanisms: resource-constrained scheduling with genuine global mode trade-offs
routing or packing with certified feasibility and cost
adaptive search under partially observed, irreversible decisions
snapshot_artifacts: solver implementation or full candidate schedule under /workspace
cheap_controls: untuned OR-Tools/CP-SAT or other available generic solver
short generic local search or beam search
reject_if: a few-minute generic solver approaches the attainable upper
an all-or-nothing case cliff creates the entire learning curve
repeating the same gadget or adding records is the only difficulty change

source_pools: pinned Lean/mathlib issue and blueprint sets
licensed papers with unformalized dependency families
task_mechanisms: weighted family of dependent Lean theorems
reusable definitions and lemmas unlocking multiple goals
snapshot_artifacts: proof modules and pinned toolchain configuration
local_feedback: open proof goals and dependency map
cheap_controls: single copied theorem from an existing formalization
reject_if: one theorem forms a binary cliff
proofs already exist under another name
toolchain or source assumptions are unpinned

source_pools: seeded original games with interpretable dynamics
task_mechanisms: stateful policy improvement over deterministic held-out episodes
planning with delayed observations and constrained actions
snapshot_artifacts: replayable agent code evaluated from a clean snapshot
reject_if: reward depends on live process state or waiting
public scenario replay reveals private episodes
